scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix v1/backend install && npm --prefix v1/frontend install && npm --prefix v2/backend install && npm --prefix v2/frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix v2/backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix v2/backend run build
scripts.dev:v1: concurrently -n v1-back,v1-front -c yellow,blue "npm run dev:v1:backend" "npm run dev:v1:frontend"
scripts.dev:v2: concurrently -n v2-back,v2-front -c magenta,green "npm run dev:v2:backend" "npm run dev:v2:frontend"
scripts.dev:shadow: concurrently -n v1,v2 -c cyan,white "npm run dev:v1" "npm run dev:v2"
scripts.build:v2: npm --prefix v2/backend run build && npm --prefix v2/frontend run build
scripts.check:v2: npm run build:v2 && npm run test:v2 && npm run security:v2
